deployments_detail.use: "Precision AI" security + Cortex XSIAM/Agentix + Prisma AIRS for AI-powered/AI-securing operations

AI-Powered Autonomous Digital Experience Management (ADEM) for Prisma SASE - uses ML/AIOps for smart discovery, insights and AI-driven remediation to detect and resolve outages impacting user experience [Palo Alto Networks ADEM / AIOps (proprietary)]

Internal generative-AI coding assistant for ~2,000+ developers to generate, optimize and troubleshoot code across languages and APIs; built in 3 months from concept to rollout [Anthropic Claude 3.5 Sonnet & Claude 3 Haiku on AWS Bedrock + Sourcegraph Cody]
deployments_detail.value: 25% average increase in developer speed (up to 40% for some teams); 2,000 developers onboarded in 3 months

deployments_detail.use: Used Anthropic Claude models on Google Cloud Vertex AI to accelerate software development and security engineering (feature development speed) [Anthropic Claude on Google Cloud Vertex AI]

Precision AI - proprietary AI system embedded across network security (Advanced Threat Prevention, Advanced URL Filtering, Advanced WildFire, Advanced DNS Security) to detect, prevent and resolve threats inline in real time [Palo Alto Networks Precision AI (proprietary)]

Strata Copilot - AI assistant for network security giving real-time actionable insights on network health/security, accessed via Strata Cloud Manager; powered by Precision AI [Palo Alto Networks Precision AI (proprietary)]

Advanced WildFire - cloud-based malware analysis using inline machine learning and patented ML detection engines to identify and block unknown/zero-day and evasive file-based threats [Palo Alto Networks (proprietary inline ML)]
Advanced URL Filtering - deep learning models that classify websites and stop unknown/evasive web-based attacks (phishing, C2) inline in real time [Palo Alto Networks (proprietary deep learning)]

Prisma AIRS - AI security platform to protect the AI ecosystem (apps, agents, models, data) against prompt injection, data leaks and unsafe outputs; AIRS 3.0 secures agentic AI [Palo Alto Networks Prisma AIRS (proprietary)]

Cortex XSIAM - AI-driven, automation-first security operations platform that centralizes data, improves threat detection and accelerates incident response for the modern SOC (autonomous SOC) [Palo Alto Networks Cortex XSIAM (proprietary)]

Cortex AgentiX - platform to build, deploy and govern AI agents that autonomously investigate incidents, contain threats and execute SOC workflows (agentic security automation) [Palo Alto Networks Cortex AgentiX (proprietary)]

Unit 42 Frontier AI Defense - integrates Anthropic Claude (Opus 4.7) for AI-driven exposure analysis, scalable application/code review and agentic threat detection and remediation with human oversight [Anthropic Claude Opus 4.7]
